verse.verse_2: when the blind came to him.
verse.verse_3: And what could let you know? Perhaps he (comes to hear you) to be purified.
verse.verse_4: (He might) remember, and the Reminder might profit him.
verse.verse_5: As for he who is sufficed
verse.verse_7: although it is not for you to be concerned if he remained unpurified.
verse.verse_8: And to him who came to you eagerly
verse.verse_11: No indeed, this is a Reminder;
verse.verse_12: and whosoever wills, shall remember it.
verse.verse_17: Perish the human! How unthankful he is!
verse.verse_18: From what did He create him?
verse.verse_19: From a (sperm) drop He created him and then determined him,
verse.verse_20: then eased his path for him,
verse.verse_21: then causes him to die and buries him,
verse.verse_22: then, He will raise him when He wills.
verse.verse_23: Indeed, he has not fulfilled that which He has ordered him.
verse.verse_24: Let the human reflect on the food he eats,
verse.verse_25: how We pour down rain in abundance,
verse.verse_27: how We made the grain to grow,
verse.verse_29: and the olive, and the palm,
verse.verse_32: for you and for your herds to delight in.
verse.verse_34: on that Day each person will flee from his brother,
verse.verse_37: Everyone on that Day will have affairs to keep him occupied.
verse.verse_40: whereas some faces will be covered with dust
verse.verse_42: Those, they are the unbelievers, the immoral.
